messages.text: What did Pocognoli change in first Scotland game in charge?

metadata.summary: A draw might not be the most inspiring result for a new era, but there were still plenty of positives for Sebastien Pocognoli to take from his first game in charge of Scotland.
metadata.content: Slovenia 0-0 Scotland: What did Sebastien Pocognoli change in first game as Scottish boss since replacing Steve Clarke? | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Slovenia 0-0 Scotland: What did Sebastien Pocognoli change in first game as Scottish boss since replacing Steve Clarke? Scotland drew 0-0 with Slovenia in Sebastien Pocognoli's first game in charge; it is the first time Scotland haven't been led by Steve Clarke since 2019; despite failing to win, there were plenty of positives for Pocognoli to take from the game Callum Bishop Football Journalist Saturday 26 September 2026 18:14, UK Image: Sebastien Pocognoli's Scotland showed promising signs in 0-0 draw with Slovenia A draw might not be the most inspiring result for a new era, but there were still plenty of positives for Sebastien Pocognoli to take from his first game in charge of Scotland. On the surface, 0-0 against Slovenia doesn't exactly scream entertaining. On another day though, Scotland could've either won by four or lost by a couple; such was the nature of the contest. In the first half they looked vulnerable, but the second completely dominant. So, what exactly did Pocognoli do to change things up for the better, and what does he still need to keep his eye on?
